item.title: Ongoing litter problem, overgrown weeds , neglected temporary fence on Bombay Street, 9th August
item.description:
There is continuous litter along the street, with an area of tall, overgrown weeds. A run-down temporary fence, heavily covered in graffiti, conceals builders’ and household waste behind it. Could the council please arrange for this area to be cleaned regularly, the weeds to be removed, a pavement litter bin to be provided, and the condition and purpose of the temporary fence to be investigated? Thank you for your attention to this matter. I would appreciate any action that can be taken to improve the cleanliness and appearance of the area.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 18, Bombay Street, Bermondsey, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
